Remote agents in Vibe. Powered by Mistral Medium 3.5.

Introducing Mistral Medium 3.5, remote coding agents in Vibe, plus new Work mode in Le Chat for complex tasks.

Highlights.

Mistral Medium 3.5 merges instruction-following, reasoning, and coding into a single dense model.

Remote coding sessions run in the cloud, can be spawned from Vibe CLI or Le Chat, and can open pull requests when finished.
